game_concept: A strategy race set in Sand Dunes – Scorpion Canyon, a canyon of scorpions: the desert nomad must handle mirage spirits while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Logic Detective: Trace code that runs but gives the wrong answer and fix the logic bug.
theme: Sand Dunes – Scorpion Canyon: a canyon of scorpions
core_gameplay_loop: In Scorpion Canyon, repeat each round: Trace code that runs but gives the wrong answer and fix the logic bug. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the desert nomad ahead. Then check the clues value and advance.
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the water well by solving code steps involving clues that move the desert nomad forward.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.95).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the water well first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 9 – Debugging & Combined Skills | Level 7 (applied tier): Logic Detective
assets_style: sun-baked pixel-art desert: golden dunes, tall cacti, a bright blue oasis, warm orange shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Logic Detective' (Week 9 slot 3), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Scorpion Canyon'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Sand Dunes
region.mood: desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how clues changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against mirage spirits in Scorpion Canyon.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.95).
